an4.230:1.1: Assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti…pe… saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti –
an4.230:1.2: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatī’’ti.
